content.contents: what does the title mean? i don't know, i guess if a girl is 'made up' of static interference, they're but a pass of phase transmitting through consciousness or something. pretend i said something really intellectual that's blown you away completely. i know, i know, i'm really, really smart.

more chocoa artwork! a beautiful moth is featured, as well as a lot of gorgeous color. i really think chocoa is something spectacular. fantastic artist. was an honor to work with him on GO UNTIL YOU ARE GONE. can't wait for the [redacted] to come out in the new year.
here's another version i made with more skewed text. in retrospect, i think i may prefer this one a bit. oh well!
